user.title: Configure SPRSUN Heat Pump
user.description:
Configure connection to your SPRSUN heat pump via Modbus TCP.

**Important:** Make sure your Elfin W11 gateway timeout is set to at least {elfin_timeout} seconds.

Recommended scan interval: {recommended_scan} seconds.

data_description.temp_step: Default 1.0°C. Some heat pump models allow finer 0.5°C control, but it is not guaranteed to work on all firmware versions.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Modbus device. Please check the host, port, and device address.

init.title: SPRSUN Heat Pump Options
init.description: Adjust configuration options. Make sure Elfin W11 timeout is at least {elfin_timeout} seconds. Changes will apply after reload.

data.enable_expert_writes: Enable Expert Settings (Diagnostics + Writes — Advanced / Risky)

data_description.temp_step: Default 1.0°C. Some heat pump models allow finer 0.5°C control, but it is not guaranteed to work on all firmware versions.
data_description.enable_derived_sensors: Exposes 10 optional calculated sensors (filtered ambient temperature without defrost spikes, operating state, ECO curve setpoint, cycle durations, water delta T, condenser approach, superheats, and experimental estimated power).
data_description.enable_expert_writes: WARNING: Exposes CHICO engineering/factory parameters (H/A/B/D/F/R, Timebands, and control bits) as both read-only Diagnostic sensors and writable Config controls. Incorrect values can damage the compressor or disrupt operation. Keep disabled unless you know what each parameter does.
